title.tr: Meslekler ve iş tanımları; gerekli nitelikler
title.en: Jobs, job descriptions and required qualities

content.anlatim:
# Vocabulary — Jobs and Workplaces

| English | Türkçe | English | Türkçe |
|---|---|---|---|
| software developer | yazılım geliştirici | applicant | başvuran, aday |
| civil engineer | inşaat mühendisi | requirement | gereklilik |
| pharmacist | eczacı | qualification | yeterlilik, diploma |
| flight attendant | kabin memuru | salary / wage | maaş / ücret |
| architect | mimar | full-time / part-time | tam / yarı zamanlı |
| vet (veterinarian) | veteriner | shift | vardiya |

# Bir İşi Tanımlamak

- **Görev:** *A pharmacist **prepares** medicine and **gives advice** to patients.* (genel doğru → **Simple Present**)
- **Gereklilik:** *You **need to / have to** have a university degree.* · *You **must** be patient.*
- **Gerekli olmayan:** *You **don't have to** work at weekends.* (zorunlu değil) ≠ *You **mustn't** be late.* (yasak)
- **Nitelik sıfatları:** *hard-working, punctual, creative, reliable, sociable, well-organised, good at maths, fluent in English*

# Yetenek ve Uygunluk Kalıpları

| Kalıp | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **be good at + V-ing / isim** | She **is good at solving** problems. |
| **be capable of + V-ing** | He **is capable of working** under pressure. |
| **be suitable for** | This job **is suitable for** people who love travelling. |
| **be interested in + V-ing** | I'**m interested in designing** buildings. |

ornekler.soru: Choose the correct option: "Doctors ___ work at night sometimes, but office workers usually ___." (a) must / don't have to (b) mustn't / have to (c) don't have to / must
ornekler.cozum: **(a)**: Doktorların bazen gece çalışması **gerekir** (*must/have to*); ofis çalışanlarının ise **gerekmez** (*don't have to*). *mustn't* "yasak" anlamı verdiği için uygun değildir.

ornekler.soru: Complete: "An architect should be good ___ drawing and capable ___ working in a team."
ornekler.cozum: **at** / **of** → *good at drawing*, *capable of working*. İki kalıpta da edattan sonra fiil **-ing** alır.

ozet: Görev tanımı Simple Present ile yapılır.
must/have to: gerekli · don't have to: gerekmez · mustn't: yasak.
be good at / capable of / interested in + V-ing.

title.tr: Gelecek planları ve tercihler: would like, would rather, prefer
title.en: Future plans and preferences: would like, would rather, prefer

content.anlatim:
# Gelecek Planları

| Yapı | Kullanım | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **be going to** | Önceden verilmiş karar / plan | I**'m going to** study medicine. |
| **Present Continuous** | Ayarlanmış (takvime bağlanmış) plan | I**'m starting** my internship next Monday. |
| **will** | Anlık karar, tahmin | Robots **will** do many jobs in the future. |
| **plan / hope / intend + to V** | Niyet | I **hope to** become a pilot. |

# Tercih Bildirmek

- **would like to + V:** *I**'d like to** work abroad.* (kibar istek)
- **would rather + V (yalın) + than + V:** *I**'d rather** work outdoors **than** sit in an office.*
- **would rather not + V:** *I**'d rather not** work at night.*
- **prefer + V-ing / isim + to + V-ing / isim:** *I **prefer** teach**ing** **to** sell**ing**.*
- **would prefer to + V + rather than + V:** *I**'d prefer to** be a vet **rather than** a doctor.*

> **Dikkat:** *would rather*'dan sonra **to gelmez** ve fiil **yalın** hâldedir: ~~I'd rather to work~~ → I'd rather work.

ornekler.soru: Choose: "I'd rather ___ a job with flexible hours." (a) to have (b) having (c) have
ornekler.cozum: **(c) have** — *would rather* yalın fiil alır.

ornekler.soru: Rewrite with *prefer*: "I like designing websites more than repairing computers."
ornekler.cozum: *I **prefer designing** websites **to repairing** computers.* — *prefer A to B* yapısında iki fiil de **-ing** alır.

ozet: Plan: be going to; ayarlanmış plan: Present Continuous; tahmin: will.
would rather + yalın fiil (+ than + yalın fiil).
prefer V-ing to V-ing; would prefer to V rather than V.

title.tr: Beğeni bildirme: gerund ve infinitive
title.en: Expressing likes: gerunds and infinitives

content.anlatim:
# Gerund (V-ing) mi, Infinitive (to V) mu?

| Sonrasında **V-ing** alanlar | Sonrasında **to V** alanlar | İkisini de alanlar |
|---|---|---|
| enjoy, mind, avoid, finish, keep, give up, can't stand, practise, suggest | want, decide, hope, plan, learn, agree, refuse, promise, would like | like, love, hate, prefer, start, begin, continue |

- *I **enjoy painting** landscapes.* · *She **decided to join** the chess club.*
- **Edattan sonra her zaman V-ing:** *I'm keen **on** collect**ing** stamps.* · *He's fond **of** cook**ing**.*
- **Özne olarak gerund:** ***Reading*** *improves your vocabulary.*

# Anlamı Değişen Fiiller

| Fiil | + to V | + V-ing |
|---|---|---|
| **stop** | bir şey yapmak için durmak: *He stopped **to take** a photo.* | bir eylemi bırakmak: *He stopped **taking** photos.* |
| **remember** | yapmayı hatırlamak (sonra): *Remember **to feed** the cat.* | yaptığını hatırlamak (önce): *I remember **feeding** it.* |
| **try** | çabalamak: *I tried **to lift** it.* | denemek: *Try **adding** some salt.* |

# Hobi Kelimeleri

*knitting, origami, rock climbing, bird watching, pottery (çömlekçilik), calligraphy, coding, baking, chess, playing an instrument*

ornekler.soru: Choose: "My brother gave up ___ video games and decided ___ the guitar." (a) to play / learning (b) playing / to learn (c) playing / learning
ornekler.cozum: **(b)**: *give up* ardından **V-ing**, *decide* ardından **to V** gelir.

ornekler.soru: What is the difference? "I stopped to talk to her." / "I stopped talking to her."
ornekler.cozum: İlki: **onunla konuşmak için durdum** (amaç). İkincisi: **onunla konuşmayı bıraktım**.

ozet: enjoy/avoid/mind/finish + V-ing; want/decide/hope + to V.
Edattan sonra V-ing (keen on, fond of, interested in).
stop/remember/try: to V ve V-ing farklı anlam.

title.tr: Yetenek: can, could, be able to, manage to
title.en: Ability: can, could, be able to, manage to

content.anlatim:
# Yetenek Kalıpları

| Zaman | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Şimdi | **can / be able to** | I **can** juggle three balls. |
| Geçmişte genel yetenek | **could** | I **could** swim when I was five. |
| Geçmişte **tek seferlik başarı** | **was/were able to, managed to** | The fire spread fast but everyone **was able to / managed to** escape. ~~could escape~~ |
| Gelecek | **will be able to** | You **will be able to** speak fluently after the course. |
| Present Perfect | **have been able to** | I **haven't been able to** finish my model yet. |

- **Olumsuz tek seferlik durumda *couldn't* kullanılabilir:** *I **couldn't** open the jar.*
- **be good at / be skilled at / be talented at + V-ing** de yetenek bildirir.
- **know how to + V:** *Do you **know how to** knit?*

# Yetenek Sorup Cevaplamak

- *Can you play any instruments?* — *Yes, I can play the bağlama, but I can't read notes.*
- *How well can you ...?* — *Not very well / Quite well / Like a professional!*

ornekler.soru: Choose: "The exam was really hard, but I ___ answer all the questions." (a) could (b) managed to (c) can
ornekler.cozum: **(b) managed to** — geçmişte **zorluğa rağmen tek seferlik başarı** için *could* değil *managed to / was able to* kullanılır.

ornekler.soru: Complete with *be able to* in the correct form: "I've practised a lot, so next year I ___ (play) in the school orchestra."
ornekler.cozum: *I **will be able to play*** — *can*'in gelecek zaman karşılığı *will be able to*'dur.

ozet: Genel geçmiş yetenek: could.
Tek seferlik geçmiş başarı: was able to / managed to.
Gelecek: will be able to; Present Perfect: have been able to.

title.tr: Past Perfect ve geçmişte olayları sıralamak
title.en: Past Perfect and sequencing past events

content.anlatim:
# Past Perfect (had + V3)

Geçmişteki bir olaydan **daha önce** tamamlanmış eylemi anlatır.
$$\text{Özne} + had + V_3$$
- *When the firefighters arrived, the fire **had** already **destroyed** the house.*
- *By the time she called, I **had left**.*
- Olumsuz: *I **hadn't seen** such a storm before.* · Soru: ***Had** they **evacuated** the village?*

# Zaman Bağlaçları

| Bağlaç | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **before** | *Before the earthquake hit, they had prepared an emergency kit.* |
| **after** | *After the flood had gone down, people returned home.* |
| **by the time** | *By the time help came, the survivors had waited for two days.* |
| **when** | *When I got to the station, the train had left.* (önce tren gitti) |
| **as soon as** | *As soon as they had heard the alarm, they ran out.* |

> *When I got there, the train **left**.* → ben vardığım an tren kalktı. *…the train **had left**.* → ben varmadan önce tren gitmişti.

# Zor Zamanlar Kelimeleri

*disaster, earthquake, flood, drought, famine (kıtlık), refugee, rescue, survivor, shelter, epidemic, poverty, injured, homeless*

ornekler.soru: Put the verbs in the correct form: "When the rescue team ___ (find) the climbers, they ___ (be) in the snow for 18 hours."
ornekler.cozum: *found* / *had been* — bulma olayı geçmişte; karda bekleme ondan **önce** başlayıp sürdü → Past Perfect.

ornekler.soru: Which sentence means the guests arrived before the dinner was ready? (a) When the guests arrived, we had cooked dinner. (b) When the guests arrived, we cooked dinner.
ornekler.cozum: **(b)**: misafirler geldi, **sonra** yemeği pişirdik. (a)'da yemek misafirler gelmeden önce hazırdı.

ozet: Past Perfect: had + V3, geçmişteki olaydan önceki olay.
by the time / before / after / when ile sıralama.
Afet kelimeleri: survivor, shelter, refugee, famine.

title.tr: Duygu ve sempati ifade etmek; yardım teklif etmek
title.en: Expressing feelings and sympathy; offering help

content.anlatim:
# Sempati ve Teselli

| Durum | Kalıp |
|---|---|
| Kötü haber duyunca | *I'm so sorry to hear that.* · *That's terrible!* · *What a shame!* |
| Teselli | *Don't worry, everything will be all right.* · *Cheer up!* · *I know how you feel.* |
| Destek | *If there's anything I can do, just let me know.* |

# Yardım Teklif Etmek ve Cevaplamak

- *Shall I help you carry these boxes?* — *That's very kind of you.*
- *Would you like me to call someone?* — *No, thanks. I can manage.*
- *Let me give you a hand.* / *Can I do anything for you?*

# Duygu Sıfatları: -ed ve -ing

| -ed (hisseden kişi) | -ing (hissettiren şey) |
|---|---|
| *I was **shocked** by the news.* | *The news was **shocking**.* |
| *The refugees were **exhausted**.* | *It was an **exhausting** journey.* |
| *frightened, depressed, relieved, worried* | *frightening, depressing, relieving, worrying* |

**Not:** *worried* sıfatı -ing ile de kullanılır: *worrying news*.

ornekler.soru: Choose: "After the long journey, the children were ___." (a) exhausting (b) exhausted
ornekler.cozum: **(b) exhausted** — çocuklar yorgunluğu **hissedenler** (-ed).

ornekler.soru: Your friend says: "I failed my driving test again." Give an appropriate response.
ornekler.cozum: *Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Don't give up — you'll pass next time. Shall I help you practise?* (sempati + teselli + yardım teklifi)

ozet: Sempati: I'm sorry to hear that / What a shame.
Yardım: Shall I…? Would you like me to…?
-ed hisseden, -ing hissettiren.

title.tr: Biyografi okuma ve yazma; Simple Past ve Past Continuous
title.en: Reading and writing biographies; Simple Past and Past Continuous

content.anlatim:
# Biyografinin Yapısı

1. **Doğum ve aile:** *Aziz Sancar **was born** in Savur, Mardin, **in** 1946.*
2. **Eğitim:** *He **graduated from** Istanbul University Faculty of Medicine.*
3. **Kariyer ve başarılar:** *He **was awarded** the Nobel Prize in Chemistry **in** 2015.*
4. **Kişisel hayat ve miras:** *He **donated** his Nobel medal to Atatürk's Mausoleum (Anıtkabir).*

# Simple Past × Past Continuous

| Simple Past | Past Continuous |
|---|---|
| Tamamlanmış eylem: *She **wrote** her first novel at 20.* | Geçmişte belli anda süren eylem: *At 8 p.m. he **was working** in the lab.* |
| Arka arkaya olaylar: *He **opened** the door and **saw** the letter.* | Yarıda kesilen eylem: *While she **was studying**, the phone **rang**.* |

- **when** + kısa eylem (Simple Past), **while** + uzun eylem (Past Continuous).
- *While I was walking home, I **met** an old friend.*

# Biyografi Kelimeleri

*be born, grow up, raise, move to, graduate from, get married, retire, pass away, achieve, invent, discover, be awarded, inspire*

ornekler.soru: Complete: "While Marie Curie ___ (work) with radioactive materials, she ___ (discover) polonium."
ornekler.cozum: *was working* / *discovered* — uzun süren arka plan eylemi (Past Continuous) ve o sırada gerçekleşen tek olay (Simple Past).

ornekler.soru: Order the biography parts: (A) She won a gold medal in 2020. (B) She was born in Ankara in 2000. (C) She started archery at the age of 12.
ornekler.cozum: **B → C → A** — doğum, başlangıç/eğitim, başarı (kronolojik sıra).

ozet: Biyografi: doğum → eğitim → kariyer → miras.
while + Past Continuous, when + Simple Past.
be born / grow up / graduate from / be awarded.

title.tr: Geçmişte hayal kurmak ve pişmanlık: should have, could have
title.en: Regrets and alternatives in the past: should have, could have

content.anlatim:
# Geçmişe Yönelik Modallar (modal + have + V3)

| Yapı | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **should have + V3** | Yapmalıydı (ama yapmadı) — pişmanlık/eleştiri | *I **should have studied** harder.* |
| **shouldn't have + V3** | Yapmamalıydı (ama yaptı) | *You **shouldn't have shouted** at him.* |
| **could have + V3** | Yapabilirdi (fırsat vardı, yapmadı) | *She **could have become** a doctor, but she chose music.* |
| **must have + V3** | Kesin çıkarım (yapmış olmalı) | *He **must have left** early; his car isn't here.* |
| **can't have + V3** | Kesin olumsuz çıkarım | *She **can't have finished** already!* |
| **might/may have + V3** | Olasılık (yapmış olabilir) | *They **might have missed** the bus.* |

# Kullanım İpuçları

- Pişmanlık dilerken: *I wish I had…* = *I should have…*: *I wish I **had listened** to my teacher.*
- Ünlülerin hayatlarını yorumlarken: *If he hadn't failed at first, he **might not have** tried so hard.*

ornekler.soru: Choose: "The lights are off. They ___ to bed." (a) should have gone (b) must have gone (c) can't have gone
ornekler.cozum: **(b) must have gone** — ışıkların kapalı olmasından **güçlü çıkarım**.

ornekler.soru: Express regret: "I didn't take an umbrella and got wet."
ornekler.cozum: *I **should have taken** an umbrella.* (ya da *I wish I had taken an umbrella.*)

ozet: should have V3: pişmanlık/eleştiri.
could have V3: değerlendirilmemiş fırsat.
must have V3 kesin, might have V3 olası, can't have V3 imkânsız.

title.tr: Geçmiş alışkanlıklar: used to, would, be/get used to
title.en: Past habits: used to, would, be/get used to

content.anlatim:
# used to + V

Geçmişte olup **artık olmayan** alışkanlık ya da durum.
- *People **used to** write letters; now they send messages.*
- Olumsuz: *I **didn't use to** like vegetables.* · Soru: ***Did** you **use to** play marbles?*

# would + V (geçmiş alışkanlık)

Yalnızca **tekrarlanan eylemler** için; durum fiilleriyle (be, have, know, like) **kullanılmaz**.
- *Every summer we **would** visit our grandparents in the village.* ✔
- ~~*I would have a bicycle.*~~ → *I **used to** have a bicycle.* (sahiplik = durum)

# be used to / get used to + V-ing / isim

| Yapı | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **be used to + V-ing** | Alışkın olmak | *I'**m used to getting** up early.* |
| **get used to + V-ing** | Alışmak (süreç) | *She is **getting used to living** in a big city.* |
| **used to + V** | Eskiden yapardı | *I **used to get** up late.* |

# Geçmişi Anlatan Kelimeler

*cassette player, black-and-white TV, telegram, typewriter, marbles (bilye), hopscotch (seksek), street vendor, nostalgia*

ornekler.soru: Choose: "When I was a child, I ___ have long hair." (a) would (b) used to (c) am used to
ornekler.cozum: **(b) used to** — *have* (sahiplik) bir **durum** fiilidir; *would* durum fiilleriyle kullanılmaz.

ornekler.soru: Explain: "I used to drive on the left." vs "I'm used to driving on the left."
ornekler.cozum: İlki: **eskiden** solda araba sürerdim (artık değil). İkincisi: solda araba sürmeye **alışkınım**.

ozet: used to + V: eskiden (artık değil).
would + V: yalnızca tekrarlanan eylem; durum fiiliyle olmaz.
be/get used to + V-ing: alışkın olmak / alışmak.

title.tr: Dilek kipleri: I wish / If only
title.en: Wishes: I wish / If only

content.anlatim:
# Şimdiye Yönelik Dilek (gerçek dışı)

$$\text{I wish / If only} + \text{Simple Past}$$
- *I **wish** I **had** a time machine.* (yok)
- *I **wish** I **were** taller.* (resmî dilde *were* tüm öznelerle)
- *I wish I **could** speak Japanese.*

# Geçmişe Yönelik Dilek (pişmanlık)

$$\text{I wish / If only} + \text{Past Perfect}$$
- *I **wish** I **had visited** my grandfather more often.* (ziyaret etmedim)
- *If only we **hadn't sold** the old house!*

# Başkasının Davranışından Şikâyet

$$\text{I wish} + \text{özne} + would + V$$
- *I **wish** you **would stop** interrupting me.*
- Kendimiz için *would* kullanılmaz: ~~I wish I would~~ → *I wish I could…*

| Dilek | Gerçek durum |
|---|---|
| I wish I knew the answer. | I don't know the answer. |
| I wish I had known the answer. | I didn't know the answer. |

ornekler.soru: Make a wish: "I can't remember my childhood friend's address."
ornekler.cozum: *I wish I **could remember** my childhood friend's address.*

ornekler.soru: Choose: "I failed the exam. I wish I ___ more." (a) studied (b) had studied (c) would study
ornekler.cozum: **(b) had studied** — geçmişte olmuş bir duruma pişmanlık → Past Perfect.

ozet: wish + Simple Past: şimdiki gerçek dışı durum.
wish + Past Perfect: geçmiş pişmanlık.
wish + someone + would: başkasından şikâyet.

title.tr: Özür dileme, mazeret bildirme ve kabul etme
title.en: Apologising, making excuses and accepting apologies

content.anlatim:
# Özür Dilemek

| Resmiyet | Kalıp |
|---|---|
| Gündelik | *Sorry!* · *My bad.* · *Oops, sorry about that.* |
| Nötr | *I'm really sorry for being late.* · *I apologise for the noise.* |
| Resmî | *Please accept my apologies.* · *I'd like to apologise for the inconvenience.* |

- **apologise (to someone) for + V-ing / isim:** *I apologise **to** you **for** forgetting your birthday.*
- **be sorry for/about + V-ing:** *I'm sorry **for** breaking your mug.*

# Mazeret Bildirmek

- *I'm sorry I'm late. **The traffic was terrible.***
- *I didn't mean to hurt you.* · *It was an accident.* · *I had no choice.*
- *I'll make it up to you.* (Telafi edeceğim.)

# Özrü Kabul Etmek / Reddetmek

| Kabul | Reddetme |
|---|---|
| *That's all right.* · *Never mind.* · *No problem.* · *Don't worry about it.* · *Apology accepted.* | *That's not good enough.* · *You should have told me earlier.* |

# Duygu Kelimeleri

*grateful, upset, offended, embarrassed, forgive, regret, misunderstanding, trust, honest, sincere*

ornekler.soru: Complete: "I apologise ___ the delay ___ your order."
ornekler.cozum: *for* / *in* (ya da *with*) → *I apologise **for** the delay **in** your order.* — *apologise for + isim*.

ornekler.soru: Your friend apologises for losing your book. Respond politely and accept the apology.
ornekler.cozum: *Never mind, it's not a big deal. Don't worry about it — I can buy another one.*

ozet: apologise (to sb) for + V-ing.
Mazeret: I didn't mean to… / It was an accident.
Kabul: Never mind / That's all right.

title.tr: Duyguları ifade etme ve tavsiye: should, ought to, had better
title.en: Expressing feelings and giving advice: should, ought to, had better

content.anlatim:
# Tavsiye Kalıpları

| Yapı | Güç | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **should / ought to + V** | Genel tavsiye | *You **should** talk to her.* · *You **ought to** apologise.* |
| **had better + V** | Güçlü tavsiye/uyarı (yapmazsan kötü sonuç) | *You'**d better** tell the truth, or she'll be angry.* |
| **If I were you, I would…** | Kendini onun yerine koyma | ***If I were you, I'd** call him.* |
| **Why don't you…? / How about + V-ing?** | Öneri | ***Why don't you** write her a letter?* |

- Olumsuz: *You **shouldn't** keep it to yourself.* · *You'**d better not** be late.* (~~hadn't better~~)
- *had better* geçmiş anlam taşımaz; **şimdi/gelecek** içindir.

# Duyguları Paylaşmak

- *I feel **hurt / lonely / disappointed / anxious** because…*
- *It makes me **feel** + sıfat*: *It makes me feel nervous when people stare at me.*
- *I can't help + V-ing:* *I **can't help thinking** about it.* (elimde değil)

ornekler.soru: Choose: "It's going to rain. You ___ take an umbrella." (a) had better (b) had better not (c) ought
ornekler.cozum: **(a) had better** — yağmur yaklaşırken güçlü tavsiye. *ought* tek başına değil *ought to* olarak kullanılır.

ornekler.soru: Give advice to a friend who feels lonely at a new school using *If I were you*.
ornekler.cozum: *If I were you, I would join a club so that I could meet new people.*

ozet: should / ought to: tavsiye; had better: güçlü uyarı.
Olumsuz: had better not + V.
If I were you, I'd… / Why don't you…?

title.tr: Edilgen yapı (Passive Voice): geniş ve geçmiş zaman
title.en: The passive voice: present and past

content.anlatim:
# Edilgen Yapı

Eylemi **kimin yaptığı** önemli değilse ya da bilinmiyorsa, **eylemin kendisi / etkilenen** öne alınır.
$$\text{Nesne} + be + V_3 \;(+\; by \;\text{yapan})$$

| Zaman | Etken | Edilgen |
|---|---|---|
| Simple Present | They **grow** hazelnuts in Giresun. | Hazelnuts **are grown** in Giresun. |
| Simple Past | Mimar Sinan **built** the Selimiye Mosque. | The Selimiye Mosque **was built** by Mimar Sinan. |
| Present Perfect | They **have restored** the bridge. | The bridge **has been restored**. |
| Modal | You **can see** Mount Ağrı from here. | Mount Ağrı **can be seen** from here. |

- **by** yalnızca yapan önemliyse eklenir: *Göbeklitepe **was discovered** in 1963 / **was excavated by** Klaus Schmidt.*
- Durum fiilleri ve nesnesiz fiiller (arrive, happen) edilgen yapılmaz.

# Türkiye Kelimeleri

*heritage site (miras alanı), landmark, cuisine, festival, carpet weaving, ancient city, ruins, fairy chimneys (peri bacaları), thermal springs, export*

ornekler.soru: Make passive: "People visit Cappadocia by hot-air balloon."
ornekler.cozum: *Cappadocia **is visited** by hot-air balloon.* (yapan "people" önemsiz olduğu için *by people* atılır)

ornekler.soru: Choose: "The Hagia Sophia ___ in the 6th century." (a) built (b) was built (c) is built
ornekler.cozum: **(b) was built** — yapı inşa edilmiştir (edilgen), olay geçmişte.

ozet: Edilgen: be + V3; yapan önemsizse by atılır.
is/are V3 (geniş), was/were V3 (geçmiş), has been V3, can be V3.
Nesnesiz fiiller (happen, arrive) edilgen olmaz.

title.tr: Yer tanıtma ve bilgi verme; turist rehberi dili
title.en: Describing places and giving information; tour guide language

content.anlatim:
# Bir Yeri Tanıtmak

- **Konum:** *Safranbolu **is located in** the Black Sea Region / **is situated** near Karabük.*
- **Ünlü olduğu şey:** *It **is famous for** its Ottoman houses.* · *It **is known as** "the city of saffron".*
- **Tarih:** *The town **dates back to** the 13th century.* · *It **was declared** a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1994.*
- **Öneri:** *You **shouldn't miss** the old bazaar.* · *It's **worth visiting** in autumn.* (**worth + V-ing**)

# Sayılar ve Karşılaştırma

- *Türkiye **is surrounded by** seas on three sides.*
- *Lake Van is **the largest** lake in Türkiye.*
- *Mount Ağrı (5,137 m) is **higher than** any other mountain in the country.*
- *Over 50 million tourists **visit** Türkiye **every year**.*

# Bilgi Sorma

- *What is … famous for?* · *When was it built?* · *How far is it from …?* · *Is it worth visiting?*

| Kalıp | Anlam |
|---|---|
| be famous for | ile ünlü olmak |
| be home to | -e ev sahipliği yapmak |
| be worth + V-ing | -meye değer |
| date back to | -e uzanmak (tarih) |

ornekler.soru: Complete: "Pamukkale is famous ___ its white travertines and is worth ___ (visit)."
ornekler.cozum: *for* / *visiting* — *be famous for*, *be worth + V-ing*.

ornekler.soru: Write one sentence introducing Ephesus with *date back to* and *be home to*.
ornekler.cozum: *Ephesus **dates back to** the 10th century BC and **is home to** the Library of Celsus.*

ozet: be located in / be famous for / be known as.
date back to, be declared, be home to.
be worth + V-ing.

title.tr: Spor kuralları: zorunluluk, izin ve yasak
title.en: Rules in sports: obligation, permission and prohibition

content.anlatim:
# Kural Bildiren Yapılar

| Anlam | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Zorunluluk | **must, have to, be required to** | *Players **have to** wear shin guards.* |
| Gereksizlik | **don't have to, needn't** | *You **don't have to** be tall to play volleyball well.* |
| İzin | **can, be allowed to, be permitted to** | *In rugby, you **are allowed to** carry the ball.* |
| Yasak | **can't, mustn't, be not allowed to** | *Football players **are not allowed to** touch the ball with their hands.* |
| Beklenti | **be supposed to** | *You **are supposed to** shake hands after the match.* |

# Spor Fiilleri: play / go / do

| play (top ve rakip) | go (-ing ile biten) | do (bireysel, dövüş sporları) |
|---|---|---|
| football, chess, tennis | swimming, skiing, cycling | judo, karate, gymnastics, yoga |

# Ekstrem Sporlar

*paragliding, bungee jumping, rafting, rock climbing, scuba diving, skydiving* — *equipment, helmet, harness, risky, adrenaline, referee, opponent, tournament, penalty*

ornekler.soru: Choose: "In basketball, you ___ run with the ball without dribbling." (a) are allowed to (b) aren't allowed to (c) don't have to
ornekler.cozum: **(b) aren't allowed to** — top sürmeden koşmak (*travelling*) kural gereği **yasaktır**.

ornekler.soru: Complete with play, go or do: "She ___ karate on Mondays and ___ cycling at weekends."
ornekler.cozum: *does* / *goes* — dövüş sporu **do**, -ing ile biten etkinlik **go**.

ozet: must/have to zorunlu; be allowed to izin; not allowed to yasak.
be supposed to: beklenen davranış.
play top oyunları, go -ing etkinlikleri, do bireysel sporlar.

title.tr: Dolaylı anlatım (Reported Speech): ifadeler ve sorular
title.en: Reported speech: statements and questions

content.anlatim:
# İfadeleri Aktarmak

Aktarma fiili geçmişse (**said, told**) zaman **bir derece geriye** kayar.
| Doğrudan | Dolaylı |
|---|---|
| "I **am** tired." | He said (that) he **was** tired. |
| "We **won** the match." | They said they **had won** the match. |
| "I **will** train harder." | She said she **would** train harder. |
| "I **can** swim." | He said he **could** swim. |

- **say** + (that) · **tell + kişi** + (that): *He **told me** that he was tired.*
- Zaman/yer kelimeleri: *now → then, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, here → there, this → that*

# Soruları Aktarmak

- **Evet/hayır sorusu → if / whether:** "Are you ready?" → *The coach asked **if** we **were** ready.*
- **Wh- sorusu → soru kelimesi + düz cümle:** "Where **do you** train?" → *She asked me where **I trained**.* (~~where did I train~~)

# Emir ve Rica

- "Run faster!" → *The coach **told** us **to run** faster.*
- "Don't give up." → *He told me **not to give up**.*

ornekler.soru: Report: The referee said, "You can't play in this match."
ornekler.cozum: *The referee said (that) I **couldn't play** in **that** match.*

ornekler.soru: Report: "When did you start running?" she asked me.
ornekler.cozum: *She asked me **when I had started** running.* — soru sırası bozulur, Simple Past → Past Perfect.

ozet: say (that) / tell + kişi; zaman bir derece geri.
Evet/hayır sorusu → if/whether; wh- soru → düz cümle sırası.
Emir → told sb (not) to V.

title.tr: Kişilik sıfatları ve insanları betimlemek
title.en: Personality adjectives and describing people

content.anlatim:
# Kişilik Sıfatları

| Olumlu | Olumsuz |
|---|---|
| reliable (güvenilir), generous (cömert), easy-going (uysal), considerate (düşünceli), loyal (sadık), outgoing (dışa dönük), sincere (içten) | selfish (bencil), bossy (otoriter), mean (cimri/kaba), arrogant (kibirli), stubborn (inatçı), moody (huysuz), jealous (kıskanç) |

# Görünüş × Kişilik

- **What is she like?** → kişilik: *She's kind and funny.*
- **What does she look like?** → görünüş: *She's tall with curly hair.*
- **What does she like?** → sevdikleri: *She likes reading.*

# Betimlemeyi Güçlendirmek

- **Derece zarfları:** *quite, rather, really, extremely, a bit* (olumsuzla): *He's **a bit** stubborn.*
- **Örnekle desteklemek:** *She's very generous — she always shares her lunch with others.*
- **Fiil kalıpları:** *get on well with* (iyi geçinmek), *fall out with* (bozuşmak), *count on* (güvenmek), *look up to* (örnek almak), *make up* (barışmak)

ornekler.soru: Choose the correct question for the answer "He's tall and has a beard." (a) What is he like? (b) What does he look like? (c) What does he like?
ornekler.cozum: **(b)** — cevap **dış görünüşü** anlatıyor.

ornekler.soru: Which phrasal verb fits? "Ali and I had an argument, but we ___ the next day." (a) fell out (b) made up (c) looked up to
ornekler.cozum: **(b) made up** — tartıştıktan sonra **barıştık**.

ozet: What is he like? kişilik · What does he look like? görünüş.
reliable, generous, loyal ↔ selfish, bossy, stubborn.
get on with, fall out with, make up, count on.

title.tr: Sıfat cümlecikleri: who, which, that, whose, where
title.en: Relative clauses: who, which, that, whose, where

content.anlatim:
# İlgi Zamirleri

| Zamir | Neyi niteler | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **who** | İnsan | *A loyal friend is someone **who** never lets you down.* |
| **which** | Nesne/hayvan | *This is the book **which** my friend gave me.* |
| **that** | İnsan ya da nesne (yalnızca tanımlayıcı) | *The girl **that** sits next to me is from İzmir.* |
| **whose** | Sahiplik | *I have a friend **whose** father is a pilot.* |
| **where** | Yer | *This is the café **where** we first met.* |
| **when** | Zaman | *I remember the day **when** we became friends.* |

# Tanımlayıcı × Tanımlayıcı Olmayan

| Tanımlayıcı (defining) | Tanımlayıcı olmayan (non-defining) |
|---|---|
| Hangi kişi/şey olduğunu belirler; **virgül yok** | Ek bilgi verir; **virgülle ayrılır** |
| *The friend **who lives in Paris** is visiting me.* | *My best friend, **who lives in Paris**, is visiting me.* |
| **that** kullanılabilir | **that kullanılmaz** |

- Zamir **nesne** ise tanımlayıcı cümlede atılabilir: *The film (that) we watched was great.*

ornekler.soru: Combine: "I have a friend. Her mother is a famous singer."
ornekler.cozum: *I have a friend **whose** mother is a famous singer.* — sahiplik → **whose**.

ornekler.soru: Find the mistake: "My brother, that is a doctor, works in Ankara."
ornekler.cozum: Tanımlayıcı olmayan cümlede **that kullanılmaz** → *My brother, **who** is a doctor, works in Ankara.*

ozet: who insan, which nesne, whose sahiplik, where yer.
Virgüllü (non-defining) cümlede that kullanılmaz.
Nesne konumundaki zamir tanımlayıcı cümlede atılabilir.

title.tr: Görüş bildirme, katılma ve katılmama
title.en: Expressing opinions, agreeing and disagreeing

content.anlatim:
# Görüş Bildirmek

- *In my opinion / In my view, …* · *I think / believe / feel that …*
- *As far as I'm concerned, …* · *It seems to me that …* · *Personally, …*

# Katılmak / Katılmamak

| Tam katılma | Kısmen katılma | Katılmama |
|---|---|---|
| *I totally agree.* · *Exactly!* · *That's a good point.* | *You may be right, but…* · *I agree up to a point.* · *That's true, however…* | *I'm afraid I disagree.* · *I don't think so.* · *I see your point, but…* |

# Gerekçelendirme ve Bağlaçlar

- **Neden:** *because, since, as, due to + isim*
- **Karşıtlık:** *however, on the other hand, although + cümle, despite + isim/V-ing*
- **Ekleme:** *moreover, furthermore, in addition, besides*
- **Sonuç:** *therefore, so, as a result*

**Örnek tartışma:** *In my opinion, respecting elders is an important value **because** it keeps families together. **However**, young people's ideas should **also** be listened to.*

ornekler.soru: Choose: "___ the rain, the festival went on." (a) Although (b) Despite (c) However
ornekler.cozum: **(b) Despite** — ardından **isim** (*the rain*) geldiği için *despite*. *Although* cümle alır: *Although it rained, …*

ornekler.soru: Politely disagree with: "Social media is the best way to learn about other cultures."
ornekler.cozum: *I see your point, but I'm afraid I disagree. Travelling and meeting people face to face teaches us much more.*

ozet: Görüş: In my opinion / As far as I'm concerned.
Kısmi katılma: I agree up to a point / You may be right, but…
although + cümle, despite + isim/V-ing.

title.tr: Toplumsal normlar: be supposed to, be expected to, be allowed to
title.en: Social norms: be supposed to, be expected to, be allowed to

content.anlatim:
# Beklenti ve Kurallar

| Yapı | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **be supposed to + V** | Toplumca beklenen (çoğu zaman yapılmayan) | *You **are supposed to** take off your shoes when you enter a Turkish home.* |
| **be expected to + V** | Beklenmek (daha resmî) | *Guests **are expected to** arrive on time.* |
| **be allowed to / be permitted to** | İzin verilmek | *In some countries, you **are allowed to** tip waiters.* |
| **It is considered + sıfat + to V** | … sayılır | *It **is considered rude to** point at people.* |
| **It is customary to + V** | Gelenektir | *It **is customary to** kiss elders' hands during Bayram.* |

- Geçmiş: *I **was supposed to** call him, but I forgot.* (beklenen ama yapılmayan)

# Değerler Kelimeleri

*respect, tolerance, hospitality (misafirperverlik), honesty, solidarity (dayanışma), generosity, custom, tradition, manners, etiquette, taboo, superstition*

# Kültürler Arası Karşılaştırma

*In Japan people bow, **whereas** in Türkiye people usually shake hands.* (**whereas / while**: karşılaştırma)

ornekler.soru: Complete: "You ___ (supposed / be) to bring a small gift when you visit someone for the first time."
ornekler.cozum: *You **are supposed to** bring a small gift…* — toplumsal **beklenti**.

ornekler.soru: What does this mean? "I was supposed to meet Ali at five."
ornekler.cozum: Ali ile saat beşte **buluşmam gerekiyordu** (planlanmıştı) — ama büyük ihtimalle **buluşmadım**.

ozet: be supposed to: toplumsal beklenti; was supposed to: yapılmamış plan.
It is considered rude/polite to V.
whereas/while: kültürleri karşılaştırma.
